changeSet.author: yakushev
changeSet.sql: create or replace view data.ref_symbols_intervals as select ref_sy.id_symbol, ref_sy.id_interval, (('kline.'::text || i.code::text) || '.'::text) || s.code::text as kline_topic, i.code as c_interval from data.ref_symbol_interval ref_sy join data.symbol s on s.id = ref_sy.id_symbol join data.interval i on i.id = ref_sy.id_interval;
